description: Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging. Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging. We offer a competitive starting salary of €55,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. . As an AI Business Analyst, you'll bridge the gap between business ambition and AI capability—identifying high-impact opportunities, designing intelligent workflows, and ensuring AI solutions deliver measurable value safely and responsibly. This role offers the unique challenge of shaping how enterprises adopt AI at scale, with direct influence on client strategy, competitive advantage, and operational excellence. You'll work alongside world-class Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and AI Specialists, gaining deep exposure to cutting-edge AI tools and methodologies while building a reputation as a trusted advisor to senior leadership. Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position Proven business analysis experience combined with hands-on AI tool adoption and delivery, demonstrating both traditional BA rigour and modern AI fluency Proven expertise in business discovery, requirements engineering, and stakeholder management across complex digital transformation programmes, with the ability to translate business challenges into AI-enabled solutions Strong foundation in Agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) and proficiency with tools like Jira or Azure DevOps, plus emerging skills in prompt engineering, context engineering, and AI agent specification Experience in regulated industries (Financial Services, Insurance, or equivalent) is highly valued, along with demonstrated capability in responsible AI governance, change management, and driving adoption at scale What type of work will I be doing? Facilitate business discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews to uncover AI and automation opportunities across business processes, from operational teams to executive leadership Design AI-enabled solutions by capturing functional, non-functional, and AI-specific requirements; engineering context for LLMs; and specifying AI prompts, prompt libraries, and agent workflows Produce structured delivery artefacts—Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria—that translate business outcomes into actionable development work Map and optimise business processes including customer journeys and future-state operating models, identifying where intelligent automation and AI can drive efficiency and value Evaluate and recommend AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Rovo, and others) against specific business needs, and assess their integration into existing systems Define success metrics and business value measures, working with stakeholders to establish clear KPIs and validate that AI outputs meet governance, privacy, and responsible AI standards Support Agile delivery cycles—sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT, and business readiness—ensuring seamless handoff from design to deployment and adoption Drive AI adoption and change management, delivering training, removing barriers to adoption, and building organisational capability to sustain AI-driven transformation Success Measures Identify and quantify high-value AI opportunities that drive measurable business outcomes Accelerate AI adoption across client organisations through effective change management and stakeholder enablement Improve productivity and operational efficiency through intelligent automation and AI-enabled process redesign Deliver AI solutions that are secure, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI and governance frameworks Build trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders and establish yourself as a go-to expert in AI-enabled business transformation Who is the Hiring Manager? The hiring manager is a seasoned AI & Strategy leader within Deloitte, recognised for their collaborative and forward-thinking approach to building high-performing teams. Their leadership style combines high expectations with mentorship, fostering an environment where curiosity, continuous learning, and bold thinking are encouraged. They prioritise open communication, empower their teams to take ownership while upholding the highest standards of responsible AI and professional integrity. Where is this role based? This role is based in Dublin, Ireland and operates on a hybrid working model , combining office collaboration with client-site engagement and remote delivery. For more information about our flexible working arrangements, visit Deloitte Works. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What We Offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options .

description: Description de l'entreprise Depuis plus de 20 ans , Talan est un groupe international de conseil et d’expertises technologiques qui accélère la transformation de ses clients par les leviers de l'innovation, la technologie et la data. Depuis plus de 20 ans, Talan conseille et accompagne les entreprises et les institutions publiques dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation et d'innovation en France et à l'international. Présent sur cinq continents, dans 18 pays, le Groupe, certifié Great Place To Work, qui comptera plus de 7200 collaborateurs fin 2024, ambitionne de réaliser un chiffre d'affaires de 850 millions d'euros cette même année et de dépasser la barre du milliard d'euros à horizon 2026. Doté d'un Centre de recherche et d'innovation, Talan met l'innovation au cœur de son développement et intervient dans les domaines des mutations technologiques telles que l'Intelligence Artificielle, la Data Intelligence, la Blockchain, pour servir la croissance des grands groupes et des ETI dans une démarche engagée et responsable. www.talan.com En plaçant au cœur de sa stratégie « L’innovation Positive » le Groupe Talan est convaincu que c’est en étant au service de l’humain que la technologie démultiplie son potentiel pour la société . #TalanBeLux Description du poste Dans le cadre de notre croissance, nous recherchons des Business Analysts pour deux de nos périmètres luxembourgeois : secteur public et financier. Votre rôle En tant que Business Analyst, vous intervenez en interface entre les équipes métiers et IT. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles (user stories, cahiers des charges) Participer aux ateliers avec les parties prenantes Suivre les phases de développement et de recette (tests, UAT) Assurer le lien entre les équipes techniques et opérationnelles Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus Qualifications Formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école de commerce, ingénieur ou université) Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Business Analyst / Consultant fonctionnel Bonne compréhension des environnements IT et des méthodologies projets (Agile, cycle en V) Esprit analytique, capacité rédactionnelles et d'écoute Maîtrise du français (niveau B2 minimum obligatoire) et de l’anglais (toute autre langue est un plus) Pour le sujet sur le secteur financier : connaissances métiers sur l'assurance vie obligatoire, connaissances de l'assurance vie luxembourgeoise est un plus. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Projets stimulants et variés Accompagnement personnalisé dans votre évolution de carrière par des personnes du métier Environnement international et multiculturel Opportunités de formation et de certification Flexibilité et équilibre vie pro / perso

description: AI Business Analyst / Change Manager 12 month extendable contract Daily rate - €550 per day Hybrid working schedule Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced AI Business Analyst / Change Manager to support the identification, assessment, and implementation of Artificial Intelligence use cases across business domains. The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between Business AI Champions and the AI IT team, ensuring that business opportunities are translated into realistic, valuable, and technically feasible AI initiatives. The role combines business analysis, change management, stakeholder engagement, and a solid understanding of AI technologies to accelerate AI adoption while ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise architecture. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate closely with Business AI Champions to identify, capture, and prioritize AI opportunities. Facilitate workshops to understand business challenges and translate them into clear AI use cases. Assess business value, feasibility, risks, dependencies, and expected benefits of proposed AI initiatives. Bridge the gap between business expectations and technological capabilities by working closely with AI architects, data scientists, and IT delivery teams. Produce business requirements, use case descriptions, process analyses, functional specifications, and business cases. Support organizational change activities related to AI initiatives, including communication, training, and adoption planning. Ensure alignment with AI governance, security, compliance, and data management principles. Required Skills & Experience: Minimum 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Change Manager, or similar role. Strong requirements elicitation, process modelling, and stakeholder management skills. Good understanding of Artificial Intelligence concepts, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Assistants and Copilots, Prompt Engineering and AI Governance. Ability to evaluate AI opportunities and understand both their business value and technical constraints. Experience supporting organisational transformation and technology adoption. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Language Requirement: Excellent spoken and written English (mandatory) Nice to Have: Experience delivering AI initiatives within a financial institution. Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI services, or similar enterprise AI platforms. Knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe). Soft Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to influence stakeholders across business and IT. Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments. Proactive, autonomous, and results-oriented. Ability to facilitate workshops, prepare professional documentation, and communicate effectively with international stakeholders.
title: Business Analyst

description: Who We Are Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. The role As a Product Manager at Helsing, you will own the discovery and delivery of products that unlock new capabilities for sovereign defence customers. This is a fully-fledged product role: you will identify what Helsing needs to build within your area and bring the company together to deliver it. Your remit spans commercial strategy, go-to-market planning, product design and technical architecture. Working directly with customers, engineers and programme leadership, you will take ideas from concept to prototype and from prototype to production, ensuring every decision is grounded in mission impact. The day-to-day Define and steward the product vision and roadmap for your area, translating operational customer needs into prioritised plans that deliver measurable capability improvements for defence end-users Lead structured discovery and co-creation sessions with customers, synthesising field insights to validate product hypotheses and shape go-to-market positioning Orchestrate cross-functional delivery across engineering, AI research and programme management, driving products from early prototype to production with clarity of purpose and pace Shape commercial strategy for your product area, partnering with senior leadership to ensure alignment with Helsing's mission and long-term growth objectives Define and track success metrics that demonstrate product impact, feeding learnings back into the roadmap and communicating progress with transparency to internal and external stakeholders You should apply if you Understand the full scope of product management, from commercial strategy and go-to-market planning through to technical architecture and product design Have guided teams through the discovery and co-creation of new products, bringing structure and clarity to complex, undefined problem spaces Learn quickly across unfamiliar domains, whether defence procurement, military systems, AI or industrial policy, and translate that knowledge into sound, well-reasoned product decisions Build effective working relationships across engineering, research and commercial functions, communicating with clarity between technical and business contexts Communicate fluently in both German and English, written and spoken, to a professional standard Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Nice to have Hold, or are eligible to obtain, a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung), which typically requires German citizenship Have prior experience working within or alongside German government, defence or public sector institutions What We Offer Competitive salary and VSOP options Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work These are the core benefits across all locations; there may be additional benefits in specific sites. Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
